defects.what: The bus in the centre has a destination sign and a front licence plate with East-Asian-looking glyphs and numbers ("A88.J"), mirrored again in the puddle.
The letters around the map (top, bottom left, bottom right) carry rows of pseudo-cursive handwriting.
The hanging banners on the left and lower right carry painted scribble pseudo-text.
The bronze plaque by the building door and the paper in Indio's hand carry rows of pseudo-text lines.
